metadata.title: 80s New Wave Band Portrait with Pop Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio group portrait featuring a central female lead in white against male band members in black leather, anchored by bold pink drop-shadowed typography.
triggerTerms: leather jacket group photo with pink text
high contrast studio lighting band cover
excludeWhen: requesting a minimalist or modern flat design
requesting a bright outdoor natural light setting
requesting a single-person portrait without graphic overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic group portrait with a shallow depth of field and dramatic side-lighting. The central figure is a blonde woman in a white denim jacket and pink gloves, surrounded by four men in black leather jackets. The composition is grounded by a large, vibrant pink sans-serif title with a grey drop shadow and a secondary white script subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the central white jacket and the surrounding black leather
Alignment of the bold pink typography across the lower third of the frame
Visual weight concentrated on the central female figure through lighting and scale
Interaction between the hard-edged display type and the fluid script subtitle
coreInvariants: Black studio background providing deep negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female figure is slightly larger and forward-facing; male figures are arranged in a semi-circle behind her.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large pink 'Transvision' text block at the bottom left-to-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the lead singer's face, moves down to the pink text, then sweeps right to the script subtitle and the supporting band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows between figures and at the top of the frame create a moody, enclosed atmosphere.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (lead singer's jacket and script text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink text against low-saturation, high-contrast photographic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses thick, uniform strokes with tight kerning
Script type mimics hand-written marker or brush strokes with varying thickness
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard heavy sans-serif forms with a hard-edged drop shadow

treatment.shadow: hard grey drop shadow offset to the right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact geometric sans-serif paired with a casual, expressive script for a 'pop-punk' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the primary title.
Captures the 80s casual marker-style script for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of five people in 80s attire (leather jackets, white denim) in a dark studio with high-contrast side lighting. Leave the bottom third of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold magenta sans-serif title with a grey drop shadow in the lower left, and a white brush-script subtitle in the lower right.

verificationChecks: Is the pink text vibrant and clearly shadowed?
Is the lighting on the faces high-contrast with deep shadows?
Does the script text appear hand-written and angled?
Is the central figure wearing white to contrast the black background?

mustRedesign: Do not use soft, diffused lighting
postGenerationChecks: Check that the pink text is legible against the clothing
Ensure the drop shadow is sharp and not blurred
Verify the script font feels like a separate hand-written element
Confirm the lead singer is the brightest point in the image
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast studio portrait + Bold Magenta Sans-Serif (Drop Shadow) + White Brush Script
